anomalies.observed: On the CAN BUS sheet, the MCP2515 devices U8 and U9 have the net CAN_CIPO attached to pin 14 (SI, peripheral input) and the net CAN_COPI attached to pin 15 (SO, peripheral output).
anomalies.expected: The schematic's own SPI naming note defines COPI as 'Controller Out, Peripheral In' and CIPO as 'Controller In, Peripheral Out'. For an MCP2515, CAN_COPI (MOSI) should connect to pin 14/SI and CAN_CIPO (MISO) should connect to pin 15/SO.

evidence.quote: SPI Naming Note: COPI 'Controller Out, Peripheral In' CIPO 'Controller In, Peripheral Out' (Power Control sheet)
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9)

anomalies.impact: The SPI data lines are swapped on both CAN controllers. If the CM4 GPIO directions follow the net names, the controller's MISO line drives the MCP2515 SI input and the controller's MOSI line conflicts with the MCP2515 SO output, preventing SPI communication and making the CAN0/CAN1 motor-control interfaces nonfunctional.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is detected: the CAN controllers' SPI data nets appear swapped (CAN_CIPO on SI and CAN_COPI on SO), contradicting the schematic's SPI naming convention and the intended MCP2515 SPI interface.
